newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S HIGH HURDLES WORLD CHAMPION JOHNSON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S HIGH HURDLES WORLD CHAMPION JOHNSON.

text.p: Profile of Allen Johnson, who won the world 110 metres hurdles world title on Thursday:
The Olympic and world champion, Johnson became the second fastest performer ever in 1996 with a personal best of 12.92 seconds, one hundredth of a second outside Colin Jackson's world record.
Ended Jackson's streak of 44 wins in February, 1995 and went on to win the world indoor 60 metres hurdles title in Barcelona.
Originally a decathlon prospect, Johnson turned to the long jump before concentrating on the hurdles.
